scripts.title: Robert's Machu Picchu Trail Dispatch
scripts.rawText:
[INTENT]
Create a UGC-style travel documentary scene set at Machu Picchu in bright Andean daylight, featuring @image1 as Robert as he films his travel vlog among ancient stone terraces.

[LOGIC]
Maintain continuous handheld POV vlog perspective, stable geographic orientation toward the Huayna Picchu peak, and consistent trail conditions. Robert's right arm remains extended forward toward the off-screen camera rig throughout. No subtitles appear on screen.

[AESTHETIC]
Medium: Handheld wide-angle travel vlog footage, natural 4K motion blur, crisp digital clarity
Palette: Vibrant emerald green terraces, weathered grey granite stone, azure Andean sky, ochre earth
Lighting: Bright high-altitude daylight, soft overcast mountain haze, natural fill
Location: Machu Picchu upper agricultural terraces, panoramic view of Huayna Picchu peak in background
Wardrobe: Robert in an olive-green breathable hiking shirt, charcoal technical trousers, khaki sun hat, trail sunglasses
Audio: Mountaineering wind gusts, distant tour murmur, footsteps on dry stone

[OPENING]
Handheld wide-angle medium shot at eye level against the backdrop of Machu Picchu stone ruins and green terraces. Frame-center, Robert stands facing screen-right with his right arm extended forward toward the lens, gazing directly into the camera with mountain mist settled across the distant peak.

[EXECUTION]
[CAM 01] Handheld wide-angle MS, eye-level -> [ACT] Robert, right arm extended forward toward the lens, stands against the stone terrace wall facing screen-right, adjusting his khaki sun hat with his left hand -> Robert says in English (enthusiastic, projecting toward the lens) {We finally made it up to Machu Picchu!} -> [ACT] Robert, right arm still extended forward toward the lens, gestures broadly with his left hand toward the open valley behind him -> Robert says in English (awed, gesturing) {Look at these views.} -> <soft scuff of fingers adjusting the sun hat brim>
[CAM 01] PAN RIGHT to follow Robert's sweep -> [ACT] Robert, right arm still extended forward toward the lens, pivots smoothly facing screen-left to sweep the view across the lower ruins, pointing with his left hand -> Robert says in English (casual, pointing) {That peak right back there is} -> Robert says in Spanish (casual, pointing) {Huayna Picchu.} -> [ACT] Robert, right arm extended forward toward the lens, lowers his left hand to his waist and nods slowly toward the mountain ridge -> Robert says in English (reflective, smiling) {Absolutely breathtaking.} -> <soft rustle of nylon hiking shirt>
[CAM 01] PUSHING IN closer to Robert's face -> [ACT] Robert, right arm extended forward toward the lens, steps forward on the dry stone step, smiling warmly into the lens while Andean sunlight catches his trail sunglasses -> Robert says in English (warm, smiling) {If you ever get the chance to come here,} -> [ACT] Robert, right arm still extended forward toward the lens, leans slightly closer to the camera and gives a firm, encouraging nod -> Robert says in English (sincere, emphasizing) {do not miss it.} -> <boot sole grinding lightly against dry granite flagstones>
